This lab gives you hands-on practice with the tools and steps you’ll use in your [Market Analysis Project](../project/project-instructions.qmd). By the end of class, you’ll have had more time to spend on the project, and a clearer idea of how to each part of the analysis is connected.

**Time:** 50 minutes

## Objectives

By the end of this lab, you will:

- Manipulate raw data and create new variables.

- Construct basic descriptive statistics and visualizations.

- Identify preliminary patterns in market structure and pricing.

- Connect your findings to the larger questions of the project.

## Notes for Students

- This lab is *not graded*; the goal is to practice, not to perfect.

- Bring your questions—the project builds on these same steps.

- Collaboration is encouraged, but each student should be engaged with the lab independently.
